This '''band''' of [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], preying on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] allied to both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Dasha Defano]] was a member of the group.
